name: How do I compare different multifamily properties effectively?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare different multifamily properties effectively?

acceptedAnswer.text: To compare different multifamily properties effectively, focus on key metrics such as the capitalization rate (cap rate), gross rent multiplier (GRM), and cash-on-cash return, alongside physical characteristics and location. Evaluate the property's condition, age, and potential for rent growth or renovations. A practical tradeoff is balancing a lower purchase price, which might indicate deferred maintenance, against a higher price for a turn-key property, considering your comfort level with renovations. Kelby Contreras assists clients in creating comprehensive comparison spreadsheets, highlighting both quantitative data and qualitative factors like neighborhood demographics and future development plans in areas like Key Biscayne or Las Olas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Effectively compare properties using metrics like cap rate, GRM, and cash-on-cash return, plus physical condition and location. Balance lower-priced properties needing work with turn-key options, considering renovation comfort.
